data.title: RED test: preconditions-validator-lib.sh entry-check and exit-write functions

content.text: ## Testing Mode RED ## Overview Write the failing test file for the shared preconditions-validator-lib.sh helper before the library exists. Tests must fail (RED) before implementation. ## File Impact - Create: tests/hooks/test-preconditions-validator-lib.sh ## TDD Requirement Write test_pv_entry_check_accepts_valid_minimal_event that calls _dso_pv_entry_check with a well-formed minimal-tier PRECONDITIONS event fixture and asserts exit code 0. Write test_pv_entry_check_rejects_schema_invalid that calls _dso_pv_entry_check with a malformed event and asserts exit code non-zero plus a diagnostic stderr line. Write test_pv_entry_check_ignores_unknown_fields (depth-agnostic: passes a standard-tier event with extra fields; asserts exit 0 — depth-agnostic forward-compat contract). Write test_pv_exit_write_emits_preconditions that calls _dso_pv_exit_write with a stage name, upstream event_id, and spec_hash; asserts a PRECONDITIONS JSON file is written to the ticket event dir with the correct schema fields. Write test_pv_exit_write_schema_roundtrip that calls _dso_pv_exit_write then reads the emitted event back through the schema validator; asserts roundtrip succeeds (SC11 self-verification). Write test_pv_exit_write_chain_link that asserts the emitted event's upstream_event_id field matches the input event_id parameter. Given/When/Then for test_pv_exit_write_schema_roundtrip: Given: a temp ticket dir, a valid upstream event_id, a spec_hash When: _dso_pv_exit_write is called Then: the written PRECONDITIONS file passes schema validation (exit 0) when parsed by the shared schema validator ## .test-index RED Markers Required Add the following RED markers before committing: tests/hooks/test-preconditions-validator-lib.sh [test_pv_entry_check_accepts_valid_minimal_event] tests/hooks/test-preconditions-validator-lib.sh [test_pv_entry_check_rejects_schema_invalid] tests/hooks/test-preconditions-validator-lib.sh [test_pv_entry_check_ignores_unknown_fields] tests/hooks/test-preconditions-validator-lib.sh [test_pv_exit_write_emits_preconditions] tests/hooks/test-preconditions-validator-lib.sh [test_pv_exit_write_schema_roundtrip] tests/hooks/test-preconditions-validator-lib.sh [test_pv_exit_write_chain_link] ## Acceptance Criteria - [ ] Test file tests/hooks/test-preconditions-validator-lib.sh exists and is executable   Verify: test -x $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/hooks/test-preconditions-validator-lib.sh - [ ] Test file contains all 6 test functions listed above   Verify: grep -c "^test_pv_" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/hooks/test-preconditions-validator-lib.sh | awk '{exit ($1 < 6)}' - [ ] All 6 tests FAIL before implementation (confirming RED)   Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/hooks/test-preconditions-validator-lib.sh 2>&1 | grep -q "FAIL\|not found\|No such" - [ ] .test-index updated with RED markers for all 6 test functions   Verify: grep -q '\[test_pv_entry_check_accepts_valid_minimal_event\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index - [ ] validate.sh --ci passes (exit 0) after this task is committed   Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/validate.sh --ci ## Retry Budget MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model) On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages) On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
